corrected_batch_method_map.interpretation: Method IDs are reconstructed from the complete unittest module commands and frozen R12 source snapshots; the batch summary does not store per-method output. Surface is the separate R11 exact-candidate run. None of these R12/R11 passes are relabeled R13 passes.

decision: No old pass is automatically promoted to R13 pass. Methods with matching test identity and no detected changed runtime/static/dynamic dependency are reviewer candidates only. Changed test files, changed runtime dependencies, resource changes or dynamic/subprocess routes require reviewer adjudication and, when unproven, current-identity execution.
purpose: Determine historical per-test identity and conservative static dependency applicability; no test execution.
static_dependency_method: AST import closure from each current test module through top-level humanmotionlib modules, plus module-wide dynamic-import/subprocess/CLI feature flags. It can overstate a method dependency and can miss dynamic/resource/config and behavioral links. Treat clean closure only as a reviewer candidate, never automatic equivalence.
